evidence.evidence_text: Prior work, primarily on GPT-style models, has identified MLP modules in early layers as key contributors to factual recall.

To address this, we conduct a comprehensive evaluation of factual recall across several models—including GPT, LLaMA, Qwen, and DeepSeek—analyzing where and how factual information is encoded and accessed.
